history.content: I'm on way too many newsletters. Fix it.

Here's what I found in the last 30 days: your actual newsletters are Morning Brew, plus a Substack digest saying you're subscribed to 12 Substacks. So the real cleanup is two moves: 1. Morning Brew, I can unsubscribe you from that directly, just say the word. 2. I have not actually checked your calendar yet, so I cannot say whether it is reachable. If you tell me which to keep (or say "cut them all"), I'll go through your Substack account and unsubscribe from the rest. Which way do you want to go on each?
